title: Monitoring.
officialText:
The design documents shall include any requirements for monitoring of the subject structure and/or
adjacent structures, as determined by the registered design professional responsible for the design. The monitoring plan shall be
specific to the buildings to be monitored and operations to be undertaken, and shall specify the scope and frequency of monitoring,
acceptable tolerances, and reporting criteria for when tolerances are exceeded.
